reason: config/routes.rb adds `get "t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe"` (and `t/:topic_id/unsubscribe`) pointing to TopicsController#unsubscribe, which changes and saves `tu.notification_level` with `tu.save!` (app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:98-113) and checks no token. The `protect_from_forgery` call in app/controllers/application_controller.rb:21 does not check GET requests, so a cross-site request that carries the session cookie will change the level; TopicView.new only limits this to topics the user can see.
